'''Soups''' were a food item served in liquid form, sometimes alongside [[Salad/Legends|salads]] or meats. They could be thickened for a better taste. It was also used as a metaphor for a particularly thick [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]].<ref name="SotME" />

Two types of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] soups included [[Gi dumpling soup|''gi'' dumpling]] and [[red gourd soup]]s, and both were served at a [[Enceri cantina|cantina]] in the [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Enceri]] on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]].<ref name="O66" />

[[Zao]] would often cook soup,<ref name="FC1">[[Dark Times—Fire Carrier 1|''Dark Times—Fire Carrier'' 1]]</ref> and had a recipe for a cold melon soup.<ref name="FC2">[[Dark Times—Fire Carrier 2|''Dark Times—Fire Carrier'' 2]]</ref>

The [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith species]] traditionally consumed a type of soup called [[bloodsoup]].<ref name="tsd">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/88/indexp2.html|text=''Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties''|int=Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties}}</ref> ~[[28,000 BBY]], [[Adas]] consumed the bloodsoup of his enemies<ref name="BoS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref> and in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], [[Githany]] offered bloodsoup to [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] after unsuccessfully trying to poison him.<ref name="jvs">[[Jedi vs. Sith 2|''Jedi vs. Sith'' 2]]</ref><ref name="pod">''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''</ref>
